evals.prompt: I want to make a YouTube video essay and companion Instagram content about how the collapse of single-screen cinemas and the rise of expensive multiplexes in India changed the physics of how Indian movies are shot, lit, and written—connecting RBI/MOSPI household consumption data and ticket economics with lens choices, aspect ratios, and storytelling shifts from classic parallel/mass cinema to modern OTT/multiplex releases.
evals.expected_output: A full multi-platform YouTube (16:9) and Instagram (9:16 Reel + 4:5 Carousel) content blueprint synthesizing Indian socio-economic data (RBI/MOSPI), optical/acoustic cinema physics, Pre-Flight Asset checklist, 135 WPM script, and Instagram loop/carousel adaptations.
expectations: Includes a Packaging & CTR Blueprint with 3 distinct working title archetypes and a YouTube/Instagram thumbnail composition spec (<= 4 word hook text)
Cites India-specific or domain-specific empirical datasets (such as RBI DBIE, MOSPI PLFS/CPI, Economic Survey, ISRO PRADAN, NASA/JWST, or UN Comtrade) alongside concrete metrics
Presents a mathematical or physical equation/formalism at M.Sc. Physics rigor paired with motion-designer math or telemetry specs
Includes a complete Pre-Flight Asset, Movie Clip, Cutout JPG & Custom SFX Checklist table with target filenames in assets/ and built-in fallbacks
Provides a timestamped spoken voiceover script & storyboard paced at ~135 WPM with explicit [AUDIO PAUSE: Xs] markers, kinetic verb-first prose, and zero banned AI cliches
Includes a dedicated Instagram Adaptation Suite containing both a 9:16 Reel script with a seamless loop ending and a 4:5 multi-slide Instagram Carousel breakdown with caption/pinned comment strategy
